subject: Intersynth AWS private offer — MAP (milestones) and billing path
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@intersynth.com>, procurement@intersynth.com
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Intersynth AWS private offer — MAP (milestones) and billing path

Hi Alyssa / procurement team,

Appreciate the time yesterday — following up with the mutual action plan (MAP) sketch we discussed for the AWS private offer. I attached a first-pass MAP (Intersynth_MAP_v1.xlsx) and our PO template for your procurement team to review. High-level summary and proposed milestones below so legal/finance have something concrete to react to: 

Summary (proposal)
- Product: Redwood Dedicated (AWS private offer, reserved capacity) + 90-day technical evaluation period.
- Initial commit: $180k / 12 months (billing via AWS private offer invoice path) with standard Redwood SLA and option to upgrade capacity after acceptance.
- Billing path: AWS Private Offer -> Intersynth accepted PO -> AWS invoices on Redwood’s marketplace listing (finance to confirm exact invoicing cadence).

Proposed MAP (milestone highlights)
1) Technical kickoff & scoping (owner: Ben / Grace) — target week of Sep 18 — deliver: config doc, access plan, test datasets.
2) Eval window start (owner: Intersynth engineering) — target Sep 25 — deliver: baseline eval runbook, perf targets for 99th%-tile latency and throughput.
3) Security/compliance review (owner: Karthik) — target Sep 29 — deliver: SOC2 evidence packet and networking diagram.
4) PO issuance & signatures (owner: Procurement / Ben) — target Oct 6 — deliver: signed PO, DocuSign route.
5) Go-live & billing activation (owner: Redwood ops / Intersynth finance) — target Oct 9 — deliver: production endpoints and AWS billing handoff.

Asks: 
- Can procurement confirm target sign date range (first/second week of October)?
- Which contact should we route the DocuSign to once PO is final?
- Any specific invoice frequency (monthly/quarterly) required for internal AP routing?

I’m available to walk through the MAP in a 30-minute call — suggested times Wed/Thu morning PT.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0126

Attachments: Intersynth_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), PO_Template_Intersynth.pdf
From: procurement@intersynth.com <procurement@intersynth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@intersynth.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@intersynth.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intersynth AWS private offer — MAP (milestones) and billing path

Ben — thanks for the summary and documents. A few quick clarifying questions from our AP/legal team before we route to signature: 

- We need confirmation that Redwood will accept AWS marketplace billing (PO issued through our internal tooling, we expect AWS to bill us monthly). Can you confirm that the private offer will be invoiced by AWS to Intersynth?
- Is there a one-time setup fee included in the quoted $180k? Please break out any non-recurring charges.
- On the security packet: do you have an exportable SSPL or vendor-hosted SOC2 report we can download (pdf)?
- For the DocuSign route, please send to procurement@intersynth.com and cc: tom.hayes@intersynth.com.

If we can get answers by EOD Friday (Sep 15), we’ll try to keep the PO timeline on track.

Thanks,
Intersynth Procurement Team
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@intersynth.com
Cc: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@intersynth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intersynth AWS private offer — MAP (milestones) and billing path

Alyssa / procurement — quick answers inline and next steps: 

- AWS marketplace billing: confirmed. The private offer will be set up so AWS invoices Intersynth directly. Redwood will provide the Marketplace Offer ID and a billing handoff guide.
- One-time setup fee: none. The $180k is annual committed spend for reserved capacity; any professional services (optional onboarding) would be billed separately — I noted a PS line in the attached MAP for transparency.
- SOC2: Karthik is attaching the evidence packet and public SOC2 PDF separately (see Redwood_SLA_Summary.pdf). If you need an export, we can provide a downloadable link or SFTP.

Next steps I’ll take this week:
- Finalize updated MAP with an explicit billing cadence section and a Marketplace Offer ID placeholder (owner: Ben) — target Sep 17.
- Karthik to send security evidence and a network diagram by Sep 16.
- Once you confirm DocuSign recipients we’ll route the PO for signature (Ben).

Proposed meeting: Thursday Sep 16, 10:00am PT for a short alignment call (30 min). I’ll send a calendar invite if that works.

Thanks — will follow up with attachments and the updated MAP.

Ben
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 Sep 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: FWD: Redwood SOC2 packet + MAP updates for Intersynth

Forwarding the security packet and a quick note on acceptance gating items.

Attachments: Redwood_SLA_Summary.pdf (SOC2 extract), network_diagram_intersynth.png (stub)

Key acceptance items for procurement/legal to validate: 
- SOC2 Type II report (we provide redacted PDF + evidence bundle) — acceptable for most enterprise contracts.
- Data residency: Redwood will deploy within AWS us-west-2 for Intersynth; no cross-region backups unless explicitly enabled.
- KMS: customer-managed keys supported (we’ll add KMS key ARN to the MAP if you choose this).
- Audit logs: 90-day retention by default; we can extend to 365 days as an add-on.

I recommend we add a short table in the MAP that maps procurement asks to evidence items (SOC2 page X -> controls; network diagram -> VPC peering notes). I’ll update the MAP draft and send to Ben to attach to the DocuSign packet.

— Karthik
Senior Security & Compliance Engineer
From: Alyssa Kim <alyssa.kim@intersynth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@intersynth.com
Cc: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@intersynth.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intersynth AWS private offer — MAP (milestones) and billing path

Ben / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the security packet. Confirming next steps from Intersynth side: 

- Procurement will accept AWS marketplace billing and intends to issue PO via DocuSign to procurement@intersynth.com (cc Tom Hayes).
- Finance prefers monthly invoices from AWS; that is acceptable for our internal AP system.
- We reviewed the MAP draft and proposed milestone dates look good; our targeted signature date is Oct 4 with production activation the week of Oct 9 (matching your proposed go-live).

Please route the DocuSign to procurement@intersynth.com once the MAP has the Marketplace Offer ID and billing cadence called out. Also please include a short one-page acceptance checklist in the DocuSign envelope so our legal can tick items off quickly.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
Alyssa
VP, Engineering | Intersynth Labs
alyssa.kim@intersynth.com | +1 617-555-0199
